detail.longDescription:
"On Mastodon, you can control whether someone can quote you. 
This post is pending while we're getting the original author's approval."

"...while we're getting the original author's approval."

Does this "approval" actually ever happen?

How would I know? After how long?

This sounds like one of those meaningless bandaids the #Mastodon devs came up with on #Github and then never bothered to flesh-out because it was always a bandaid on the issue anyway that no one important ever cared about

And what am I supposed to do?

#Bookmark the post and go back to it time after time over days and weeks, to see if anything's changed?

If it's finally been #Approved that I may see it?

Worthless...

#MastoHelp #QuotePost #QuotePosts #QuotePostApproval
